description: Call this tool to render one client's A4 deposit statement and return a download link valid for one hour. Titled DEPOSIT STATEMENT, every movement in date order, closing with what is still held. Pro.

as_of.description: YYYY-MM-DD printed as the statement date. Defaults to today

client.description: Client id, exact name or a name containing this text

currency.description: Only needed when the client has deposits in more than one currency

out_path.description: Name for the downloaded file, e.g. acme-deposits. Defaults to the client and currency; the statement comes back as a download link valid for one hour

name: deposit_statement_pdf
title: Render the deposit statement as a PDF
